title: expected.json
description: What validating an analysis case of the ASTRA conformance suite gives (conformance/README.md).

about.description: What the case is, in one sentence.

root.description: The folder of the analysis to validate, from the top of the working folder.

valid.description: Whether the analysis is valid: no analysis of its stack breaks a MUST of the parse, schema or validator layer.

must_report.description: The diagnostics the validator reports, each matched by a diagnostic with its code and, where given, its file and pointer.

code.description: The code of a parse, schema or validator rule of rules.json.

file.description: The file the diagnostic is in, from the top of the repository that holds it.

pointer.description: The JSON Pointer of the place in the file, "" for the whole file: given only for a parse or schema code, which the specification places (Schema files).

must_not_report.description: The codes the validator reports nowhere.
